entities.name: Mehrangiz Manoochehrian
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehrangiz Manouchehrian was an Iranian lawyer, musician, feminist, and appointed Senator. She was involved in the Women's Organization of Iran. She was involved in drafting the Family Protection Act - a set of laws extending women's rights in marriage.
